query:
INSERT INTO managementAccounts (companyId, branchId, code, name, description, nature, costType, classification, impactMargin, impactPayroll, isActive, displayOrder, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT 2, 1, code, name, description, nature, costType, classification, impactMargin, impactPayroll, isActive, displayOrder, NOW(), NOW()
FROM managementAccounts
WHERE companyId = 1 AND isActive = 1;
